youtube_title: 'Power Will Be Cut Tonight' SMS? It's a Scam #Shorts
youtube_description:
Scam of the Week #3. The SMS says your electricity will be disconnected tonight at 9 PM because your last bill was 'not updated', and asks you to call an 'electricity officer'. It's a scam: PIB Fact Check has confirmed the Ministry of Power issues no such notices. On the call, the fake officer asks for bank details or makes you install a remote-access app that lets him control your phone, and then empties your account.
The rule: check your bill only on your power company's official app or website. Don't call unknown numbers and don't install apps. Got scammed? Call the cyber fraud helpline 1930 or report on cybercrime.gov.in.
Source: PIB Fact Check (Feb 2023).
